head: Instagram Edits video editor now on Mac, free with 4K export
dek: Instagram released Edits for Mac, its free video editor, with a multi-track timeline, keyframes, color grading tools, 4K export without a watermark and direct publishing to Instagram.
details: You can import your own LUTs and fonts, set keyboard shortcuts, use Instagram's licensed music, and get unlimited automatic captions in several languages. Editing the same project on Mac and phone isn't possible yet. Instagram says the desktop app gets weekly updates.
means: If your phone feels too small for editing Reels, you can now edit on a Mac for free.
todo: Download Edits for Mac from Instagram's Edits page and sign in with your Instagram account.
